sources.title: John Voight, Shimura curve computations

sources.title: John Voight, Computing CM points on Shimura curves arising from cocompact arithmetic triangle groups, corrected author version
sources.use: The arithmetic Artin inverse-principalizer convention. We use the underlying CM reciprocity law, not triangle-group analytic algorithms or the separate Section 6 descent claim.

sources.title: Lassina Dembele, A hyperelliptic Shimura quotient of genus 16
sources.use: Canonical adelic setup and Cerednik-Drinfeld uniformization over the completed maximal unramified extension, with its prime-to-p adelic action. Together with CM reciprocity this gives the localized ideal action in the specified local CM character. The paper's hyperellipticity assertion is not used.

project_deductions: The full integer ring embeds into R for W and both normalized signs of the eight ordinary reversed edges; exact matrices conjugate all seventeen generators to [0,-lambda;1,0].
The torus-unit argument gives exact order-two stabilizers; k anticommutes with W and exchanges its eigenlines, making W the unique inertia-fixed, hence K-rational, point of D.
The principal dyadic prime splits in H/M. A simple rational Hensel root and the remaining Newton slopes independently prove uniqueness of the K-root.
The local embedding is normalized by W's CM eigenvalue character. Prime-to-p adelic equivariance transports the arithmetic Artin convention to the localized ideal relation, also for ramified M_p/K.
Seventeen exact principal class witnesses relative to (31,beta+16) certify all classes; norm products supported at 2 and localized inclusion prove the requisite right-ideal equalities.

An exact principal witness makes sigma(beta)=beta^3+3*beta act on the class group by 10. Its root cycle determines the regular C17 subgroup; the certified D107 resolvent selects the unique arithmetic class orientation.
Independent rational Hensel checks give root errors at least 688 beta-digits and separation at most 17; all 272 rational residue-frame entries have error at least 384 beta-digits.
At the rational anchor, eta1=theta-2/17 has v2=7 rather than 1; the failed expectation is archived and the correct valuation follows from the independent rational root center.
The certified reducer gives all 51 actual zeroth-moment vectors, with A0=0 and B0+C0=0, including nonzero B0 values.
excluded_inferences: No new explicit unramified-descent matrix; inertia uses the existing uniformization over the completed maximal unramified field.
